name: friberg-lol-community
description: 弗一把 · 英雄联盟版——社区衍生的职业选手猜测小游戏

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm data:validate && pnpm data:sync-runtime && pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
scripts.test: pnpm test:data && pnpm data:validate && pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter client test
